title: XChem Solvent Test for Crystal Growth
author: Peter Marples

steps.title: Image and Select Crystal Drops
steps.instruction: Image all required sitting drop crystal plates using a crystal plate imager and select drops with suitable crystals.

substeps.instruction: Select 38 drops total for a standard test: 2 control drops and 12 drops for varying solvent concentrations across three time points.

steps.title: Calculate Solvent Requirements
steps.instruction: Calculate the volume of solvent needed to achieve final concentrations of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30% v/v based on the drop volume.

substeps.instruction: Designate two drops as controls (0% v/v solvent).

steps.title: Dispense Solvent
steps.instruction: Dispense the calculated solvent concentrations (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30%) into individual drops in duplicate.

substeps.instruction: If using a targeting system, target the drops for dispensing rather than targeting the crystals directly to avoid damage.

steps.title: Incubate Crystals
steps.instruction: Store the plate in the incubator for 01:00:00 at either 4 °C or 20 °C, depending on the crystal growth temperature.

steps.title: Add Cryoprotectant
steps.instruction: If cryoprotectant is required for harvesting, add the necessary volume to the crystal drops just before the full soaking time ends.

steps.title: Prepare Harvesting Tools
steps.instruction: Select a tray of loops sized to match the crystals as closely as possible (e.g., 35 µm, 75 µm, 150 µm, or 300 µm) to improve data quality.

steps.title: Prepare Pucks and Cooling
steps.instruction: Place pucks in a foam dewar and cool them with liquid nitrogen while wearing appropriate PPE.

steps.title: Mount and Plunge Crystals
steps.instruction: Mount the crystal in the loop and plunge it into liquid nitrogen, placing the sample into a puck.

substeps.instruction: Record the success or failure of each mounting attempt.
Continue until all harvestable samples are mounted.

steps.title: Store and Collect Pucks
steps.instruction: Place lids on the pucks, store them, and send them for collection.

steps.title: Iterate Soaking Durations
steps.instruction: Repeat the incubation and cryoprotectant addition steps two additional times to achieve total solvent soaking durations of 01:00:00, 02:00:00, and 03:00:00.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Based on the results, determine the highest % v/v solvent and longest soaking time that yielded viable data to inform future experiments.
